title: Paintings Need Glass (PNG)
description: Client-side mod that adds support for transparent painting textures.
body:
Paintings Need Glass (PNG) is a client-side mod which adds support for transparent painting textures.

These textures can be used through resource packs, data packs or other mods.

The mod can be toggled in-game with the command `/paintingsneedglass toggle`.

Rendering of painting's side textures can be toggled with `/paintingsneedglass togglesides`.

Alternatively, both settings as well as the horizontal offset of the painting texture on the config screen, accessible through [Mod Menu](https://github.com/TerraformersMC/ModMenu).
